time_zones.option.description: A time zone in a choice of the time zone (the settings' zone of the app, an event's zone), under the name of its part of the world (time_zones.region). place is the zone's place as the time zone database names it, in English (Tokyo, Buenos Aires); offset is how far its clocks are from UTC now, as the reader's language writes it (GMT+9).

time_zones.region.defaultMessage: {region, select, Africa {África} America {América} Antarctica {Antártida} Arctic {Ártico} Asia {Asia} Atlantic {Océano Atlántico} Australia {Australia} Europe {Europa} Indian {Océano Índico} Pacific {Océano Pacífico} other {Otros}}
time_zones.region.description: The name of a group of time zones in a choice of the time zone (the settings' zone of the app, an event's zone): the part of the world its places are in. region is the first part of the zones' names in the time zone database (Asia of Asia/Tokyo); the three oceans are named as oceans (Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Pacific Ocean). The choice offers no zone of another part, so other shows nowhere today.
